design_note: Ambiguous middle. Strong spark + aligned (shared) faith, but BOTH currently low in maturity / poor repair and somewhat rigid. Per human label: conditional leaning YES, because shared faith and God can help them grow past low maturity OVER TIME, and CONDITIONAL on having counsel/community around them. Tests whether the system credits external support (faith, counsel, community) as a real lever on growth, rather than assuming people change alone.

person_a.name: Ravi
person_a.summary: Engineer, passionate and devout, shared faith with Mei, but conflict-avoidant and proud.

values.faith: Devout; faith is central; shares Mei's tradition and community.

emotional_profile.maturity: Low-moderate — slow to apologize, gets defensive, avoids hard talks.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: Low-moderate now, BUT open to growing through faith and mentorship; has a pastor/mentor and small group.

person_a.life_stage: Ready to commit; embedded in a faith community.
person_a.support_context: Both are embedded in an active faith community with a mentor couple and regular counsel available.

person_b.name: Mei
person_b.summary: Teacher, warm and devout, shares Ravi's faith, but reactive and quick-tempered under stress.

values.faith: Devout; same tradition and community as Ravi; central to life.

emotional_profile.maturity: Low-moderate — reactive, struggles to self-soothe, but remorseful after.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: Low-moderate now, but earnestly wants to grow; leans on faith and the mentor couple.

person_b.support_context: Shared faith community, mentor couple, and access to pastoral counseling.
